author: Fable (autonomous), on behalf of the LUCID program
motivation: LUCID's gap-gated curriculum ended at lambda=0.756 and never trained on the full evaluation envelope; it trails fixed full-range DR by 2.29 pts full-DR success (54.25 vs 56.54) while preserving clean success (83.99 vs 80.39). TACE keeps a fixed cohort of envs on the full envelope throughout so the target distribution never leaves the training mixture.

design.origin_checkpoint: logs_rl/TRL_G1_Track/manager/universal_token/all_modes/sonic_release_test-20260818_141446/model_step_000024.pt (settled origin, identical to the 2026-08-20 three-arm run)

arms.lucid: gap-gated PI curriculum, all envs (replicates the 2026-08-20 arm on the new commit)
arms.ta_lucid_25: lucid focus cohort (96 envs) + 32 anchor envs pinned to lambda=1; controller reads the tracked focus env only; no consolidation phase
arms.ta_yoked_25: same cohorts; replays ta_lucid_25's lambda trajectory for the same seed with no feedback (attribution control)

controller.note: identical across lucid and ta_lucid; the return guard reads the global mean return in both arms

design.smoke_first: ta_lucid_25 seed 8600, 16 iterations: cohort sizes exact (32/96), anchor delay mean > focus delay mean, controller received gap samples, exit 0. No outcome is read from the smoke.

evaluation.evaluator: run_curriculum_robustness_eval.py, frozen policy, no learning, 102-motion content-dev panel (training-seen motions; fresh physics), eval seeds 8700-8702 matched to checkpoint seeds
evaluation.primary_endpoint: dr_full success_rate, cross-seed mean of per-seed values
evaluation.profile_summary: mean of success over {id_clean, dr_050, dr_full} as a coarse area-under-profile

hypotheses.H_A_headline: ta_lucid_25 dr_full success >= fixed dr_full success - 2.0 pts (non-inferiority) AND ta_lucid_25 id_clean success >= fixed id_clean success + 2.0 pts
hypotheses.H_A2_over_lucid: ta_lucid_25 dr_full success > lucid dr_full success by > 2.0 pts (closes the support gap)
hypotheses.H_B_attribution: ta_lucid_25 dr_full success > ta_yoked_25 dr_full success (favorable in >= 2 of 3 seeds); a tie attributes the effect to schedule shape/dose, not online feedback
hypotheses.H_C_mechanism: ta_lucid_25 terminal lambda (focus cohort) is not lower than lucid's by more than 0.1 (anchor exposure does not suppress the curriculum) and anchor-cohort realized delay mean exceeds the focus-cohort mean in every iteration after warmup

decision_rules.three_seeds_are_screening: with three checkpoint seeds this pilot is an effect-size screen; paper-grade claims require five seeds and untouched confirmation seeds
decision_rules.noise_floor: training-side settled floor 3.33% relative; deployment success differences under ~2 pts on three seeds are treated as ties
decision_rules.no_tuning: anchor ratio fixed at 0.25 for the pilot; 0.50 may be run afterwards as a second preregistered cell, never selected post hoc on the same panel
decision_rules.negative_result: if H_A fails, report it; do not add consolidation, replay, or per-channel control to rescue the pilot

not_yet_verified: everything above; this file is written before any TACE branch has run on the GPU
